primary_endpoint: First charged evaluation reaching the single validation-derived inner macro-F1 target; unreached is censored.
descriptive_capped_endpoint: Unreached assigned budget+1; never call this an uncensored target-time estimate.
inference: Average seeds within dataset. Pair shaped against random, PPO, retrieval, simple retrieval, and final configuration; enumerate task bootstrap and exact two-sided sign flips.
multiplicity: Exploratory comparisons; no confirmatory multiple-comparison-adjusted claim.
decision: Report all methods regardless of sign. Do not retune using final outcomes. Three tasks cannot establish conventional sign-flip significance.
